methods.formula: Total addressable market = China's total carbon credit demand (tons) × average carbon credit price (USD/ton)
variables: China carbon credit demand (from national ETS cap)
preferred_sources: China National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC)
search_queries: China national ETS cap 2025
China carbon credit price Shanghai exchange 2024
known_limitations: Assumes full compliance and liquidity; actual trading volumes may be lower.

methods.formula: Market size = Σ (emissions from covered sectors × reduction requirement) × carbon price
preferred_sources: Ministry of Ecology and Environment (MEE) reports
search_queries: China power sector CO2 emissions 2023
China steel sector emission reduction target 2025
known_limitations: Data granularity varies; some sectors not yet covered by ETS.

methods.formula: Market size = Number of companies covered × average compliance cost per company
search_queries: China ETS covered companies list 2024
Baowu carbon compliance cost annual report
known_limitations: Compliance cost data is often proprietary; estimates may be rough.

methods.formula: Value pool = (carbon credit trading volume × price) + (green technology investment) + (energy efficiency services)
search_queries: China carbon market trading volume 2023
China renewable energy investment 2024 BNEF

methods.formula: Market size = Total carbon credit supply (from offset projects) × price
search_queries: China CCER issuance volume 2024
China CCER price 2024
known_limitations: CCER supply is intermittent and policy-dependent.

chart_data_needs.title: China Carbon Intensity vs. Target Trajectory (2020-2030)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Is China on track to meet its carbon intensity reduction targets?
preferred_sources: IEA CO2 Emissions from Fuel Combustion
search_queries: China CO2 emissions 2020 2021 2022 2023 IEA
China GDP 2020 2021 2022 2023 World Bank
China carbon intensity target 2025 2030 NDRC
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use IEA data for actual emissions; GDP from World Bank constant USD. If 2023 data is provisional, note as estimate.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Establishes the gap between policy ambition and actual progress, setting the stage for urgency.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: China has pledged to reduce carbon intensity by 65% by 2030 from 2005 levels. Decision makers need to know if current trends support this.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Actual intensity reduction is lagging behind the linear target path, implying policy acceleration or market mechanisms will be needed.

chart_data_needs.title: Provincial Carbon Intensity Heatmap
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Which provinces offer the best opportunities for carbon credit projects?
search_queries: China provincial carbon intensity 2023 data table
China energy intensity by province 2023 NDRC
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use official NDRC data; if some provinces missing, note as unavailable.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Identifies geographic disparities that create arbitrage and investment opportunities.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: China's carbon intensity targets are set nationally but implemented provincially. Some provinces are far ahead, others lagging.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Provinces with high intensity and low reduction progress (e.g., Inner Mongolia, Ningxia) present the largest need for carbon credits and green tech investment.
